ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: Investigate the growing concern of Medicaid fraud, including the DOJ’s Second National Health Care Fraud Takedown and the Minnesota Medicaid fraud investigation.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in the US?
How is the DOJ investigating Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that Medicaid fraud is a significant issue that requires further investigation. By following the money and examining the DOJ’s investigation, we may uncover more widespread fraud and shed light on this important issue.
